subject: general
question: The Grand Trunk Road was built by:
solution:
the correct answer is __**Sher Shah Suri.**__

__
 
• The** ****Grand Trunk Road was built by Sher Shah Suri****,** a 16th-century ruler.
 
• It was known as "Sadak - e - Azam".
 
• The road connected India to Central Asia and was crucial for inland trade.
 
• This road was earlier known as " Uttarapath ", " Badshahi Sarak ", and " Sarak - e - Azam ".
 
• It is Asia's oldest and longest major road.
 
• The length of this road is 3,710 Km.
 
• The east end of this road is Teknaf, Bangladesh and the west end of this road in Kabul, Afghanistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sher Shah Suri was born in Sasaram, Bihar as “Farid Khan”.
 
• He defeated Humayun in the Battle of Chausa (1539) and took control of the Mughal Empire until his death in **1545.**
